title: Ivysaur 4-4-8 – Week A – Day 1
creator: u/Ivysaur (r/Fitness)
description: Ivysaur's 4-4-8: three full-body days a week over a two-week rotation, each lift alternating a heavy 4×4 and a lighter 4×8 (the 8-rep weight is 90% of the 4-rep weight). Bench and overhead press every session, squat/deadlift and chin-up/row alternating. The third day of each week swaps two lifts' last sets for an AMRAP: 8+ reps doubles next week's jump. Weekly increases: squat/deadlift +15 lb (7.5 kg), bench/row +10 lb (5 kg), press +5 lb (2.5 kg); chin-ups add 2.5 lb after two clean sessions; fail the reps → drop 10%.
